messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nUsers risk double-counting payments because reporting periods cannot be locked. This undermines data accuracy and financial integrity.\n\n## Who is affected\n- The account Brackwater Homecover is affected, as they have explicitly asked for a way to lock reporting periods [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n\n## Evidence\n- A user from the account Brackwater Homecover asked, That’d be great — also, is there a way to lock reporting periods so payments don’t get double-counted? [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n- This request came through the support route [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n- There is 1 total mention of this issue across all routes [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n- The support route has 1 mention of this issue [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n- The account Brackwater Homecover has 1 mention of this issue [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n- The account Brackwater Homecover has an ARR of 610000.0 GBP [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n- There are 1 total accounts in the fact sheet [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n- There have been 0 renewals in the last 90 days [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n\n## Why now\n- The request was made on 2026-09-10 [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n- The fact sheet data is current as of 2026-10-01 [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].\n- The account Brackwater Homecover has a renewal date of 2027-10-10 [i:977dc85cf0bfb926].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "977dc85cf0bfb926",
   "quote": "That’d be great — also, is there a way to lock reporting periods so payments don’t get double-counted?",
   "account": "Brackwater Homecover",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-10T10:12:00+00:00"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-10-01",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "support": 1
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 610000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Brackwater Homecover",
    "arr_gbp": 610000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-10-10",
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked every claim against the cited insight and fact sheet. The quoted user request matches the insight verbatim and is correctly attributed to Brackwater Homecover via the support route. All figures — 1 total mention, 1 support mention, 1 account mention, ARR of 610,000 GBP, 1 account in the fact sheet, 0 renewals in 90 days, fact sheet as of 2026-10-01, and the renewal date of 2027-10-10 — match the fact sheet exactly. The insight date (2026-09-10) is also cited correctly, and no contrary evidence exists to omit. The scope is appropriately limited to the one affected account.", "verdict": "pass"}
